title: ALDH3A2, ODF2, QSOX2, and MicroRNA-503-5p Expression to Forecast Recurrence in TMPRSS2-ERG-Positive Prostate Cancer.
authors: Kobelyatskaya, Anastasiya A; Kudryavtsev, Alexander A; Kudryavtseva, Anna V; Snezhkina, Anastasiya V; Fedorova, Maria S; Kalinin, Dmitry V; Pavlov, Vladislav S; Guvatova, Zulfiya G; Naberezhnev, Pavel A; Nyushko, Kirill M; Alekseev, Boris Y; Krasnov, George S; Bulavkina, Elizaveta V; Pudova, Elena A
one_liner_zh: 该文利用深度学习预测前列腺癌复发，核心是临床预后标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Following radical surgery, patients may suffer a relapse. It is important to identify such patients so that therapy tactics can be modified appropriately. Existing stratification schemes do not display the probability of recurrence with enough precision since locally advanced prostate cancer (PCa) is classified as high-risk but is not ranked in greater detail. Between 40 and 50% of PCa cases belong to the TMPRSS2-ERG subtype that is a sufficiently homogeneous group for high-precision prognostic marker search to be possible. This study includes two independent cohorts and is based on high throughput sequencing and qPCR data. As a result, we have been able to suggest a perspective-trained model involving a deep neural network based on both qPCR data for mRNA and miRNA and clinicopathological criteria that can be used for recurrence risk forecasts in patients with TMPRSS2-ERG-positive, locally advanced PCa (the model uses ALDH3A2 + ODF2 + QSOX2 + hsa-miR-503-5p + ISUP + pT, with an AUC = 0.944). In addition to the prognostic model's use of identified differentially expressed genes and miRNAs, miRNA-target pairs were found that correlate with the prognosis and can be presented as an interactome network.
abstract_zh: 根治性手术后，患者可能面临复发风险。识别此类患者对于适时调整治疗策略至关重要。现有的分层方案在展示复发概率方面不够精确，因为局部晚期前列腺癌（PCa）虽被归类为高风险，但未进行更细致的分级。约40%至50%的PCa病例属于TMPRSS2-ERG亚型，该亚型具有足够的同质性，使得高精度预后标志物搜索成为可能。本研究包含两个独立队列，基于高通量测序和qPCR数据。由此，我们提出了一种基于深度神经网络的预测模型，该模型结合了mRNA和miRNA的qPCR数据及临床病理标准，可用于TMPRSS2-ERG阳性、局部晚期PCa患者的复发风险预测（模型使用ALDH3A2 + ODF2 + QSOX2 + hsa-miR-503-5p + ISUP + pT，AUC = 0.944）。除了预后模型中使用的差异表达基因和miRNA外，还发现了与预后相关的miRNA-靶点对，这些对可以呈现为交互网络。
